name: morph-popover
title: Morph Popover
description: A button that morphs into a small feedback form, its label becoming the panel title. Escape or an outside click folds it back; it swaps without morphing under reduced motion.

props.name: label
props.description: The button's label. It becomes the panel title.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional leading icon on the button.

props.name: sentLabel
props.description: Label of the button after a message was sent.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the trimmed text when the form is submitted.

props.name: align
props.description: Edge of the button the panel grows from.

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the open panel in pixels.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
